review_candidates.description_excerpt: We are looking for a highly experienced L3/L4 Network & Security Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Routing, Switching, Enterprise Firewalls, Network Implementation, Troubleshooting and Migration Projects . review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Position Summary Senior engineer who both leads the service and performs hands-on remediation on the most complex and security-critical systems. Basic Qualifications 6–10 years in network/security engineering with a strong vulnerability management background. Deep hands-on patching and upgrades of security infrastructure — next-gen firewalls (Palo Alto / Fortinet), NAC (Cisco ISE), IPS/IDS and network devices — plus servers, virtualization, and cloud. Preferred Qualifications Preferred the certifications in CCNP Security or CCIE Security; PCNSE (Palo Alto) or Fortinet NSE; Cisco ISE; Qualys VMDR; CISSP or CISM; ITIL.
